summary: 现金链路只读核对快照首片（无迁移/无写入口）：新增 pmo_plugins/cash/reconciliation_services.py，按公司聚合 posted 现金 → 有效 CashClassification → 账本 AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting/bank_effect claim → 退款/银行退回 → 内部互转成对，并经既有 classification_services.cash_book_coverage 汇总各银行账户现金账净额（含冲销，非银行余额）。提供 cash_bridge_snapshot（逐流水投影 + 账户净额 + 汇总）与 cash_bridge_issues（issue_code/refs/期望/实际异常清单，覆盖分类缺失/重复、事件缺失/重复、posting 数量/金额/账户范围不符、claim 缺失/净额不符、退款+退回超 gross、互转缺腿/金额日期不一致/跨 org）；refund/return 反向现金按退款事实覆盖、不误报未分类。offset_implemented 固定 false 占位（PH-241 未合入，不伪造 offset 事实）。owner/finance/auditor 只读；pm/member 拒绝；快照不写任何现金/账本/审计事实，无收据。浏览器新增只读快照/异常清单页与筛选（as_of/账户）。

deviations: PM access: the spec says pm may read only the cash-flow summary of projects they manage, but PH-239/240/245 cash facts (CashTransaction/FundingAccount/Refund/BankReturn/InternalTransfer/classification) carry no project attribution, so a project-scoped pm summary cannot be derived without leaking company-wide cash. This slice therefore denies pm (403) together with member rather than exposing org-wide cash, and discloses the spec/runtime mismatch for a future planning slot.

Module-disabled read: the named read services (cash_bridge_snapshot/cash_bridge_issues) intentionally keep history readable when the cash module is disabled (check_module=False semantics, matching existing cash read services); the browser routes are still gated by the plugin runtime snapshot and return 403 when the module is disabled. The service-level history read is tested; the HTTP 403 is the existing runtime behavior and is disclosed.
Offset: PH-241 is in_review and not a dependency; the snapshot exposes offset_implemented=false (and a per-row offset placeholder note) and never invents an offset fact, per the spec.

The snapshot is derived per request from existing owner facts/read helpers; it adds no table, migration, receipt, session persistence or generic audit write (the spec made the audit optional, so the read path stays side-effect free).

Refund/return reverse cash facts are intentionally unclassified and covered by the Refund/BankReturn fact; they are marked derived_cash=refund/bank_return and excluded from classification_missing so the gold case stays issues=[].
No verify_integrity assertion was changed or added; issue codes are aligned to the existing cash verification vocabulary but the snapshot does not mutate or extend the command.

Single worker owns the whole write set (cash reconciliation service/views/template/domain metadata, delivery urls, two test files, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.
